decision_table.name: Determine_ND_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file North Dakota state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in ND (office, employees, property)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
ND filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
A corporation has physical presence nexus in ND if it has: - An office, store, warehouse, or other place of business in ND - Employees working in ND - Tangible personal property located in ND - Real property located in ND
Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38.1 (Nexus and apportionment) Reference: ND Office of State Tax Commissioner Guideline (Nexus standards)

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
ND filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
Economic nexus threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in ND.
Following South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), ND requires filing if a corporation exceeds economic nexus thresholds, even without physical presence.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: ND Office of State Tax Commissioner Economic Nexus Guidance Reference: ND Century Code § 57-40.2 (Economic nexus provisions)

No ND nexus - no filing requirement.
Corporation does not meet physical presence or economic nexus thresholds. Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38.1 (Nexus requirements)

decision_table.name: Calculate_ND_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate ND state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
ND state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
ND ADDITIONS to federal taxable income include: - Interest income from U.S. government obligations (exempt federally, taxable to ND) - IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback (ND does not conform) - State income taxes deducted on federal return - Bonus depreciation addback (varies by tax year) - Expenses related to exempt income
ND SUBTRACTIONS from federal taxable income include: - Interest on ND state and municipal bonds - ND net operating loss deduction (subject to ND limitations) - Dividend income eligible for ND dividend received deduction (85%) - Agricultural commodity processing facility investment - Certain refunds of state income taxes
Reference: ND Form 40 Schedule SA (State Adjustments to Federal Taxable Income) Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38-01.3 (Adjustments to federal taxable income)

No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.
Corporation does not have ND nexus, so no income adjustments are needed.

decision_table.name: Calculate_ND_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate ND state corporate income tax. Applies ND 3.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
ND state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to ND: × [ND apportionment percentage] 3. ND additions: + [Federal interest, IRC 199A addback, etc.] 4. ND subtractions: - [ND municipal interest, ND NOL, etc.] 5. ND taxable income: = [Result] 6. ND tax rate: × 3.5% (reduced from 4.31% in 2024) 7. ND income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. ND credits: - [Renaissance Zone, seed capital, biodiesel, geothermal, etc.] 9. ND tax liability: = [Final tax]
ND uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor).
ND tax rate history: - 2025+: 3.5% (reduced rate) - Prior: 4.31%
ND provides various tax credits including: - Renaissance Zone tax incentive credits - Seed capital investment tax credit - Biodiesel and green diesel fuel production credit - Geothermal energy device tax credit - Agricultural commodity processing facility investment credit
Reference: ND Form 40 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38-30.3 (Tax rate of 3.5%) Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38.1 (Single-sales apportionment) Reference: ND Office of State Tax Commissioner Corporate Tax Guidance

No ND nexus - no tax liability.
Corporation does not have physical presence or economic nexus in ND. Any estimated payments are refunded.
Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38.1 (Nexus requirements)

No ND taxable income - no tax liability.
Corporation has ND nexus but no positive taxable income after apportionment and adjustments. Any estimated payments are refunded.
ND net operating loss (NOL) rules may apply: - ND allows NOL carryforward for 20 years - No carryback allowed (as of 2025) - NOL limited to 80% of taxable income (similar to federal)
Reference: ND Form 40 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Reference: ND Century Code § 57-38-30.1 (Net operating loss deduction)
